categories.main_business_segments: Beijing OriginWater Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in environmental protection and water treatment, covering a full industry chain. Its main business areas include municipal and industrial wastewater treatment and resource recovery, industrial water supply, high-quality reclaimed and drinking water, seawater desalination, wetland protection and restoration, urban and watershed ecosystem management, salt lake lithium extraction and resource recycling. The company also has a subsidiary focusing on light technology solutions for urban, scenic, and residential lighting. The business is divided into environmental overall solutions, operation services, municipal and drainage engineering, and light technology overall solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in membrane technology with independent intellectual property rights covering microfiltration, ultrafiltration, nanofiltration, and reverse osmosis membranes. Key technologies include membrane bioreactor (MBR) technology, vibration membrane bioreactor (V-MBR) technology, MBR-DF dual membrane new water source technology, and UF-RO dual membrane seawater desalination integration. It also develops lithium adsorption materials and advanced catalytic oxidation catalysts. Production methods emphasize automated, intelligent, and green manufacturing processes, including full automation of membrane element production lines and recycling of waste membranes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves municipal governments, industrial parks, and enterprises requiring wastewater treatment, water supply, and resource recovery solutions. Key markets include urban and rural sewage treatment, industrial wastewater zero discharge, seawater desalination for coastal areas, salt lake lithium extraction, and high-quality drinking water production. It also targets emerging markets such as semiconductor ultra-pure water and industrial zero discharge sectors. Overseas markets include Malaysia, Mauritania, Namibia, Dubai, Mexico, Russia, and Italy.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Beijing and Tianjin and projects across major river basins such as the Yangtze, Yellow River, and Taihu Lake. It has expanded overseas with projects in Southeast Asia, Africa, and Europe. Domestic operations cover urban and rural areas nationwide, including key provinces like Shandong, Hebei, Hubei, and Xinjiang. The company also participates in national strategic initiatives like the Belt and Road and Yellow River ecological protection.
categories.supply_chain_position: OriginWater operates across the full water treatment supply chain, including upstream R&D and manufacturing of core membrane materials and components, midstream production of membrane modules and equipment, and downstream engineering, construction, and operation services. It provides integrated EPC and PPP/BOT project delivery and ongoing operation and maintenance services, positioning itself as a comprehensive solution provider in the water treatment industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in membrane technology, focusing on energy-efficient MBR systems, high-performance nanofiltration and reverse osmosis membranes, seawater desalination, industrial zero discharge, and salt lake lithium extraction technologies. It invests over 3% of sales in R&D, developing intelligent control systems for precise dosing and process optimization. Strategic R&D projects include vibration MBR technology, high-selectivity nanofiltration membranes, industrial wastewater zero discharge solutions, and lithium extraction materials. The company also emphasizes green manufacturing and digital transformation to support sustainable development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through direct sales of membrane products and equipment, engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) contracts, operation and maintenance services under PPP/BOT/ROT models, and integrated solution provision including light technology services. The company also earns income from licensing and technology services. Sales are primarily conducted via direct sales channels, with a mix of product sales and recurring operational service fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: OriginWater is a leading high-tech environmental protection enterprise in China and ranks among the top global membrane product manufacturers and advanced environmental equipment suppliers. It is recognized as a national champion in manufacturing and holds a dominant position in large-scale MBR projects worldwide. The company competes with other domestic and international membrane technology and water treatment firms, leveraging its comprehensive membrane technology portfolio, strong R&D capabilities, and integration with state-owned capital groups to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately 8.55 billion RMB, a slight decline of 4.51% from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of about 58.6 million RMB, down 92.34%. Total assets reached nearly 79.7 billion RMB, with a 4.2% increase year-over-year. Despite profit declines due to market conditions and losses in key associates, the company maintains steady business operations and continues to invest in strategic emerging industries. It has a large production capacity for membranes and lithium adsorbents and is expanding its market presence domestically and internationally.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: OriginWater emphasizes its fully independent intellectual property in full-chain membrane technologies, offering advanced, energy-efficient, and high-quality water treatment solutions. Its patented vibration MBR technology reduces energy consumption by over 20% while improving nitrogen removal, and its MBR-DF dual membrane technology achieves high-grade reclaimed water standards with lower operating pressures and energy use. The company leads in domestic production of high-performance membranes, replacing imports, and integrates digital and green manufacturing processes. Its comprehensive solutions address water pollution, resource scarcity, and drinking water safety, providing customers with reliable, sustainable, and cost-effective water treatment technologies.
